# Recyclable Scroller

> Virtualized (recycling) ScrollRect for Unity 6 uGUI: lists and grids of thousands of items that create only visible cells and reuse them. Subclass `RecyclableScrollRect<T>`, implement `IRecyclableCell<T>`, initialize with `ListDataSource<T>`. Dynamic cell sizes, expandable cells, headers, reversed lists, filtering, pull to refresh and pagination, with optional dependency injection. Requires Tools Core. MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x).
